about: 2026-10-31: costume variants (src/variants.c) in the arcade's Royal Rumble: the player picks the 1999 Undertaker at the Rumble's select (the Undertaker's box, C-right past Type 4); ONE UNDERTAKER IN THE RUMBLE on: the field (drawn from every page's boxes and their variants) never has the stock Undertaker. state.csv (qa_variant 4): bs_step = where 0x00A / 0x003 are in the Rumble's list (+1; 0 none) | its size << 16

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: the player is the 1999 Undertaker (picked through the Undertaker's box)
the list: him first, 30 drawn, no stock Undertaker
the stock Undertaker never in a slot
expect.check: 0x0003 not in (s0_id, s1_id, s2_id, s3_id, s4_id, s5_id)
